risk.title: RSF expansion in Blue Nile state triggers displacement and protection risks
risk.rationale_short: The RSF offensive launched in early 2026 against SAF positions in Baw county opened a new front in Blue Nile state, raising the likelihood of conflict spreading north towards Ed Damazine and the Roseires Dam corridor.

triggers.title: RSF advances north from Baw
triggers.description: RSF movement towards Ed Damazine or the Roseires Dam corridor would indicate expansion beyond current front lines and increase displacement risk.

questions.title: ACAPS rating
questions.text: ACAPS rates this risk High probability and impact 4/5. Do you agree?
questions.text_fr: ACAPS évalue ce risque à une probabilité élevée et un impact de 4/5. Êtes-vous d'accord ?

questions.text: Will the RSF advance north from Baw towards Ed Damazine or the Roseires Dam corridor before 6 May 2027?
